title: Freight Pallet Receiving and Forklift Service Rate Card — Bluegate Business Storage Account
content:
Palletized freight receiving and forklift unloading by facility staff are offered on two programs of the Bluegate Business Storage Account. The rate card lists, for every program, whether each service is offered and its rate.

| Program | Palletized freight received | Fee per pallet received | Forklift unloading by staff offered | Fee per started hour of forklift service |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Business Essentials | No | $0.00 (not offered) | No | $0.00 (not offered) |
| Bluegate Business Plus | No | $0.00 (not offered) | No | $0.00 (not offered) |
| Bluegate Business Pro | No | $0.00 (not offered) | No | $0.00 (not offered) |
| Bluegate Business Logistics | Yes | $15.00 | Yes | $45.00 |
| Bluegate Business Fleet | No | $0.00 (not offered) | No | $0.00 (not offered) |
| Bluegate Business National Account | Yes | $12.00 | Yes | $40.00 |

**Unit of charge.** The pallet fee is charged per pallet received. The forklift fee is charged per started hour, so any part of an hour counts as a full hour.

**Worked rates (hypothetical quantities).**

- Bluegate Business Logistics receives 3 pallets: 3 at $15.00, $45.00.
- Bluegate Business National Account receives 3 pallets: 3 at $12.00, $36.00.
- Bluegate Business Logistics uses the forklift for 1 hour 20 minutes: 2 started hours at $45.00, $90.00.
- Bluegate Business National Account uses the forklift for exactly 2 hours: 2 started hours at $40.00, $80.00.
